desc:
Welcome to Ride a Boat Down a Waterslide!

How to play:
- 🚢 Ride your boat to increase the distance.
- 🌊 Use this distance to buy more boats.
- 💲 Reach the end of the radial coin multiplier!
- 💣 Use your cannon to blow up other boats!

- 🎁 Like to receive updates and rewards in the future!
- 👥Join a group to choose a boat for you and two friends to board:
https://www.roblox.com/share/g/151747107
